desc:
Marketplace order processing and shipping support keeps your orders moving on time. Ecom Swift LLC sets up a clear daily routine in your seller account and processes a set number of your orders during the starter sprint.

## What is marketplace order handling?

Marketplace order handling is everything between a buyer clicking Buy and the parcel arriving: seeing the new order, buying or printing the label, confirming shipment with tracking, answering questions and dealing with returns or cancellations. Each marketplace sets deadlines for these steps and measures how well you meet them.

The routine is simple to describe and easy to neglect. One missed day can produce several late shipments at once.

## Why timing matters so much

Marketplaces track metrics such as late shipment rate, cancellation rate and response time. Poor numbers can reduce your visibility, trigger warnings or lead to account restrictions. Buyers also judge you by speed, because they usually compare delivery dates before choosing a seller.

Messages deserve the same care. A question that waits for days often becomes a negative review or a claim. A clear, polite reply on the same working day usually settles it.

## How a working routine affects results

A routine turns order handling from a daily scramble into a repeatable job. Orders are checked at set times, labels are printed in batches and tracking is uploaded before the deadline. That protects the account metrics that marketplaces use to judge sellers.

It also protects your time. When the steps are written down, anyone on your team can follow them, and the work does not depend on one person's memory. We cannot promise any specific rating or ranking. The routine removes avoidable causes of late and cancelled orders.

## What a good order routine includes

- Set times each day to check for new orders on every channel.
- A step-by-step process for printing labels and uploading tracking.
- Shipping templates and carrier settings that match what you offer buyers.
- Message templates for common questions, delays and address problems.
- A return and refund process that follows the marketplace's rules.
- Rules for handling cancellations and out-of-stock items.
- A late shipment alert, so deadlines never pass unnoticed.
- A daily order summary showing what shipped and what is waiting.
- A handover guide so your staff can continue after the sprint.

## How the sprint works

We first read your account settings, your handling times and your carrier options. Then we write the routine and set it up in your account. During the sprint we process orders for you in the account, covering the order count in your package, and we reply to buyers using agreed templates.

The Basic package documents the routine and processes a first batch of orders. Standard adds returns handling, shipping templates and a larger order count. Premium covers a full week of handling with daily summaries, buyer replies within one business day, a metrics check and a guide for your staff. We do not ship the parcels. Postage, labels and packaging costs are paid by you.

## What to do and what to avoid

**Do:**
- Keep stock close to the packing table so orders can go out the same day.
- Set handling times you can meet with room to spare.
- Upload tracking as soon as a label is created.
- Reply to buyer messages before the response deadline.
- Photograph high-value parcels before they leave.

**Avoid:**
- Cancelling orders late to hide a stock error.
- Quoting arrival dates to buyers that the shipping service cannot meet.
- Leaving return requests unanswered.
- Moving buyers to email or phone against marketplace rules.
- Letting orders pile up over the weekend.

## Who it is for

A seller who ships from home and has started missing deadlines as volume grows. A business that has just opened a marketplace channel and has no routine yet. An owner who wants to hand order work to staff and needs a clear process to give them.

## What we need from you

We need a user in your seller account with permission to view orders and reply to messages, plus your shipping method and carrier details. You keep control of payment and labels charged to your account. We never ask for passwords. Tell us your cut-off times and how you want returns handled.
